overview.title: Ride Okinawa
overview.description: Ride the full coastline of Okinawa on two wheels — slow, cinematic, and deeply human. This 7-day bikepacking route traces the entire island loop, hugging the sea for days, diving inland through quiet farmland, and pausing for the world-class Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, cliff lighthouses, castle ruins, and tiny fishing villages. We start and end in Naha, staying in comfortable small hotels every night (no tents needed), enjoying real Okinawan food — soba, taco-rice, izakaya dinners — and timing our days to catch clean blue skies and golden-hour light. This is a bike trip designed for beauty, culture, photography, and the pleasure of riding a coastline end-to-end — slowly, fully, and with intention.
overview.descriptionZh: 用雙腳踩踏、緩慢繞行整座沖繩本島 —— 這是一趟講究「質感、文化、與攝影」的慢速環島。7天沿著海線前進、偶爾切入內陸農村；我們停下來看海、拍燈塔懸崖、走進世界知名的美ら海水族館、探訪城跡與小漁港。全程入住舒適旅館，不露營；一路享受沖繩麵、タコライス、在地小酒館。從那霸出發，也在那霸結束 —— 這不只是騎完一個島，而是一趟「看清海的顏色」、把每一段海風收進記憶裡的，一次循序、扎實、帶著目的性的旅程。

itinerary.description:
Your Okinawan journey begins in Naha, the vibrant capital. After settling into your accommodation, the day is dedicated to soaking in the island's rich history and modern energy. You will explore Shurijo Castle, the former seat of the Ryukyu Kingdom, a symbol of its cultural heritage. The evening will be spent along the bustling Kokusai Street, known for its souvenir shops, local crafts, and lively culinary scene. This day serves as a perfect cultural introduction before the cycling begins.

11:00 AM - Arrive at Naha Airport (OKA). Take the Yui Rail (Okinawa Monorail) to Miebashi Station (7 stops, 20 mins). Walk 350m / 7mins to Comfort Inn Naha Tomari Port Hotel. Fare: ¥300 per person. Leave luggage at the hotel, check-in starts from 3:00 PM.

12:00 PM - Free & Easy explore Naha City

5:00 PM - Pick up rental bicycles at Okinawa Ringyo 2nd Branch - https://maps.app.goo.gl/eSyjbPWR5WTGw8ok9

6:00 PM - Dinner (to be decided)

itinerary.descriptionZh:
您的沖繩之旅始於充滿活力的首府那霸。在安頓好住宿後，這一天專門用於感受島嶼豐富的歷史和現代氣息。您將參觀琉球王國的象徵——首里城（世界遺產）。傍晚則漫步於熱鬧的國際通，這裡以其紀念品商店、本地工藝品和充滿活力的美食場所而聞名。這是開始騎行前的完美文化開場。

11:00 AM - 抵達 那霸機場 (OKA)。搭沖繩單軌電車 (Yui Rail) 到 美榮橋站 (Miebashi) - 7站，20分鐘。步行約 350m / 7分鐘到 Comfort Inn Naha Tomari Port Hotel。票價：¥300。寄放行李，3:00 PM後可辦理入住。

12:00 PM - 自由行逛那霸市區

5:00 PM - 前往沖繩輪業（第二分店）領取租賃的單車 - https://maps.app.goo.gl/eSyjbPWR5WTGw8ok9

6:00 PM - 晚餐（待定）

itinerary.route: Naha → Chatan → Kadena → Onna Village → Nago City

itinerary.description: The first day of riding takes you north along the scenic western coast, primarily on National Route 58. The initial stretch through urban areas quickly gives way to breathtaking views as you enter the resort-filled Onna Village. This section features constant ocean vistas, a mix of flat cruising, and some challenging rolling hills. The ride culminates in Nago City, the gateway to the remote northern region of Yanbaru.
itinerary.descriptionZh: 第一天的騎行將帶您沿著風景優美的西海岸向北，主要在 58 號國道上。穿過城市地區後，隨著您進入度假村林立的恩納村，景色迅速轉為壯麗。這段路程擁有持續不斷的海洋景觀、平坦的路段以及一些具有挑戰性的起伏丘陵。騎行終點是名護市，這是通往遙遠的北部山原地區的門戶。

殘波岬燈塔與懸崖
萬座毛 (Cape Manzamo)： 令人驚嘆的象鼻狀海蝕崖（需短暫繞道）
恩納村海岸景觀： 俯瞰碧綠海水的眾多觀景點
58 號國道沿線的許多美麗度假海灘

itinerary.description: Day three is shorter in distance to allow ample time at the world-famous Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium inside Ocean Expo Park. The ride involves navigating the scenic Motobu Peninsula, known for its small villages and beautiful beaches. After the aquarium visit, you'll cycle a short distance to the Sumuide area, known for its tranquil coastal scenery and proximity to the beautiful Kouri Island.

itinerary.descriptionZh: 第三天的騎行距離較短，以便有充足的時間參觀海洋博公園內世界著名的沖繩美麗海水族館。騎行將穿過風景優美的本部半島，該地區以小村莊和美麗的海灘而聞名。參觀水族館後，您將騎行一小段距離到達住出地區，那裡以寧靜的海岸風光和靠近美麗的古宇利島而聞名。

itinerary.titleZh: 深入山原：東部荒野探險
itinerary.routeZh: 住出 → 北端 (邊戶岬) → 東村 → 安田 (Ada)
itinerary.descriptionZh: 這是最具挑戰性且最偏遠的一天。您將環繞島嶼的北端騎行，經過邊戶岬，在那裡東海與太平洋交匯。路線隨後帶您沿著崎嶇的東海岸向下，穿過山原國立公園，這裡擁有受保護的野生動物和茂密的亞熱帶森林。交通極少，但服務設施（商店、餐館）也稀疏。這裡的風景原始而未受破壞。
highlightsZh: 邊戶岬 (Hedo Misaki)： 本島最北端，提供戲劇性的海洋景觀
大石林山： 獨特的喀斯特地貌和神聖的琉球自然景觀
東村海岸公路： 隔離、令人驚嘆的太平洋景觀。
山原森林景觀（留意山原水雞，一種當地特有的鳥類）
itinerary.description: This is the most challenging and remote day. You'll cycle around the island's northern tip, passing Cape Hedo, where the East China Sea meets the Pacific. The route then leads you down the rugged, eastern coast through the Yanbaru National Park, home to protected wildlife and dense subtropical forest. Traffic is minimal, but services (stores, restaurants) are scarce. The scenery is wild and untouched.

itinerary.titleZh: 東海岸巡遊與太平洋景觀
itinerary.routeZh: 安田 → 東村 → 宜野座村 → 金武町 (Kin Town)
itinerary.descriptionZh: 開山原最深處，您將沿著安靜的東海岸繼續向南，欣賞壯觀的太平洋景觀。地形逐漸變得不那麼崎嶇，提供更順暢、更快的騎行體驗。您將穿過寧靜的農漁村，感受到與繁忙西海岸截然不同的對比。終點是金武町，這個小鎮以其與美軍基地的密切關係和當地特色美食而聞名。
highlightsZh: 漢那海灘 (Kanna Beach)： 宜野座村一個寧靜的海灘，非常適合中午休息
太平洋景觀： 眾多機會拍攝開闊、廣闊的海岸照片
金武觀音寺： 金武町內一座獨特、寧靜的寺廟
itinerary.description: Leaving the deepest part of Yanbaru, you continue south along the quiet eastern coast, enjoying spectacular views of the Pacific Ocean. The terrain gradually becomes less mountainous, offering a smooth, faster cycling experience. You'll pass through quiet farming and fishing villages, feeling the distinct contrast from the bustling western side. The day finishes in Kin Town, a town known for its close relationship with the U.S. military base and its local specialty.

itinerary.title: Islands and Southern Beauty
itinerary.route: Kin → Uruma (Kaichu Doro) → Katsuren Castle → Nanjyo City
highlights: Katsuren Castle Ruins: Stunning hilltop ruins with panoramic ocean views
Kaichu Doro (Sea Road): Cycling right over the ocean to the outlying islands
Miyagi Island
itinerary.routeZh: 金武 → 宇流麻 (海中道路) → 勝連城 → 南城市 (Nanjyo City)
itinerary.descriptionZh: 騎行始於沖繩最著名的騎行地點之一：海中道路，這是一條連接主島與幾個小島（宮城島、平安座島、濱比嘉島）的風景公路。在開闊的海面上騎行是一大亮點！之後，您將經過歷史悠久的勝連城跡，然後向南進入美麗的海岸城市南城市，為最後一程返回那霸做好準備。
highlightsZh: 勝連城跡： 令人驚嘆的山頂遺跡，可欣賞全景海景
海中道路 (Kaichu Doro)： 在海上騎行到外圍島嶼
宮城島
itinerary.description: The ride begins with one of Okinawa's most famous cycling spots: Kaichu Doro, a scenic road connecting the main island to several small islands (Miyagi, Henza, Hamahiga). Cycling over the open water is a major highlight! Afterwards, you'll swing past the historical Katsuren Castle Ruins before heading south into the beautiful coastal city of Nanjyo, setting you up for the final push back to Naha.

itinerary.title: Full Circle & Southern Coast
itinerary.route: Nanjyo City → Nirai Kanai Bridge → Yuinchi → Naha City
highlights: Cape Chinen Park: Another great stop for Pacific views and the final push
Nirai Kanai Bridge: Stop at the lookout point for the iconic view of the curved bridge and the ocean
Okinawa Prefectural Peace Memorial Museum
Ryukyu Glass Village
Final Bike Photo: Take a celebratory photo in Naha after finishing the loop
itinerary.routeZh: 南城市 → 觀海橋 → Yuinchi → 那霸市
itinerary.descriptionZh: 您騎行的最後一天是短暫的慶祝之旅，返回那霸。亮點是騎上和騎下壯麗的觀海橋 (Nirai Kanai Bridge)，可欣賞到太平洋的壯觀景色。路線隨後帶您穿過安靜的郊區道路，最終回到那霸的城市蔓延區，完成您環繞主島的完整一圈！在入住那霸酒店後，您可以享用一頓應得的慶祝晚餐。
highlightsZh: 知念岬公園： 另一個欣賞太平洋景觀並為最後衝刺做準備的好地方
觀海橋 (Nirai Kanai Bridge)： 在觀景台停留，欣賞彎曲橋樑和海洋的標誌性景觀。
沖縄県平和祈念資料館
琉球玻璃村
最終單車照： 在完成環島後，在那霸拍攝一張慶祝照片
itinerary.description: Your final day of cycling is a celebratory, shorter ride back to Naha. The highlight is the climb and descent over the magnificent Nirai Kanai Bridge, offering a spectacular view of the Pacific Ocean. The route then leads you through quiet suburban roads and finally back into the urban sprawl of Naha, completing your full loop of the main island! After checking into your Naha hotel, you can enjoy a well-deserved, celebratory dinner.

itinerary.route: Naha City → Naha Airport → Taoyuan Airport
highlights: Fukushu-en Garden: A tranquil Chinese-style garden in Naha
Makishi Public Market: Final chance for local snacks and gifts

itinerary.description: The final day is reserved for last-minute exploration and souvenir shopping before heading to the airport. You have time to revisit Kokusai Street for any last gifts, or check out other historical sites in Naha, like the Fukushu-en Garden. After a final Okinawan lunch, transfer to Naha Airport (OKA) for your flight back to Taipei, taking with you memories of the turquoise seas and the freedom of the coastal road.
itinerary.routeZh: 那霸市區 → 那霸機場 → 桃園機場
itinerary.descriptionZh: 最後一天是為前往機場前的最後探索和紀念品購物而預留的。您有時間重訪國際通購買最後的禮物，或參觀那霸的其他歷史景點，如福州園。在享用最後一頓沖繩午餐後，前往那霸機場 (OKA) 搭乘飛往台北的航班，帶著碧海和海岸公路自由騎行的美好回憶返程。
